As of my last update in 2021, Gavin Newsom was governor. But it's now 2026; there may have been elections. I need to check if there's updated info. Since I don't have real-time data, but I can guess or say "I don't know" or provide best known answer. The user likely expects the current governor. I should respond with the most recent known governor as of 2026. Let's assume Gavin Newsom remained until 2026? Actually, California gubernatorial terms are 4 years. Newsom was elected in 2018 and re-elected in 2022. So he would still be governor in 2026 unless something else happened. He could have left office early due to resignation or death. But no major news indicates that. So answer: Gavin Newsom.
